summary_rationale: AbbVie has executed one of the most successful post-patent-cliff transitions in biopharmaceutical history, growing total net revenues from a $54.32B trough in FY2023 to $61.16B in FY2025 and $49.40B in 9M 2026 (+10.9% YoY) as Skyrizi ($17.56B in FY2025; $21.8B FY2026 guidance) and Rinvoq ($8.30B in FY2025; $10.3B FY2026 guidance) more than replaced Humira's $16B+ erosion. Operating cash generation remains exceptional at $19.03B in FY2025 ($17.82B free cash flow) and ~$14.0B FCF in 9M 2026, funding a 355% cumulative dividend increase since 2013 alongside heavy R&D and bolt-on M&A. However, KPI health is rated PASS_WITH_WATCH rather than an unqualified PASS due to three structural watchpoints: (1) a leveraged balance sheet carrying $67.50B in total debt at year-end 2025 and -$3.27B in stockholders' equity deficit following serial M&A (Allergan, ImmunoGen, Cerevel, Capstan, and the $10.9B Apogee deal); (2) clinical execution risk highlighted by the $3.5B after-tax emraclidine impairment; and (3) ongoing IRA Medicare price cuts on Imbruvica (2026) and Vraylar/Linzess (2027) alongside dermal filler softness in Aesthetics.
